description: A ring modulator: it multiplies one signal by another, or by a built-in oscillator that can be swept from sine to sawtooth

params.text: Chooses what does the modulating: the built-in oscillator at OSC, or the MOD input at AUDIO
Sets the oscillator's pitch, two octaves either side of 440Hz
Morphs the built-in oscillator from a sine at one end to a sawtooth at the other, crossfading between the two shapes

inputs.text: The signal that does the modulating when the source switch is on AUDIO; it is ignored when the switch is on OSC
Adds to the oscillator's pitch, an octave per volt, with the total held within four octaves either side of 440Hz

outputs.text: The two signals multiplied, on a scale where 5V stands for 1, so two 5V signals give 5V out

notes: with the switch on OSC and a steady voltage at the carrier input the module works as a plain oscillator, since multiplying by a constant only sets the level.
the oscillator keeps running whichever way the switch is set, so flipping to OSC picks it up wherever it has got to rather than starting it from zero.
the shape knob and the pitch controls do nothing while the switch is on AUDIO.
